name: A Symmetric Escape
description:
About This Game

Explore and solve your way through the gloomy halls in which you find yourself stuck. Thinking symmetrically will be key! Isolated and environmental puzzles feature in this (almost) pure puzzle experience.


Explore the halls to find puzzles blocking your progress. They might be simple, in-your-face, puzzles or more subtle puzzles which involve the environment around you.


Progress further, and explore multiple paths as you try to escape. Or go for 100% puzzle solves and get onto the leader board. An (almost) pure puzzle experience.

Key Features

  • Isolated and environmental symmetry-based puzzles.
  • Branching paths and a gloomy retro-inspired aesthetic.
  • Steam achievements and leader boards.
  • About 1.5h - 3h gameplay for most players.
